responsibility: This file implements generation of D runtime type information objects. It determines which `TypeInfo` derivative layout is required for each frontend type, builds internal POD-compatible record layouts matching druntime’s `object.d` ABI, creates and emits the corresponding `TypeInfoDeclaration` or `ClassInfo` data, handles special cases such as builtin/runtime-supplied typeinfos and C++ typeinfo bridges, and includes logic for suppressing speculative typeinfo emission when template instantiations are not meant to generate code.
